sub: 4 prompts that do it for you

cards.title: The 10-line summary
cards.prompt: Turn this transcript into: decisions, action items (owner + date), open questions. Max 10 lines.

cards.title: The follow-up email
cards.prompt: Write a follow-up email to the attendees from these notes. Decisions first, then action items. Under 120 words.

cards.title: Walk in prepared
cards.prompt: I'm meeting [who] about [topic]. Give me the 3 questions they'll most likely ask and a one-line answer to each.

cards.title: The agenda in 10 seconds
cards.prompt: Turn this goal into a 30-minute agenda with timings and the one decision we need by the end: [goal]

Save this. You'll want it after your next meeting.

hook: Stop losing an hour to email.
sub: 4 email prompts that save an hour a week

cards.title: Triage 20 emails at once
cards.prompt: Sort these emails into Reply today / This week / Ignore. Draft a one-line reply for each Reply today.

cards.title: Get a reply, fast
cards.prompt: Rewrite this email: lead with the ask, under 80 words, one clear deadline, friendly but direct.

cards.title: Say no without guilt
cards.prompt: Help me decline this request politely. Keep the relationship warm and offer one alternative. Under 70 words.

cards.title: The polite nudge
cards.prompt: Write a short follow-up to this unanswered email. Restate the ask in one line and suggest a next step. Under 50 words.

caption:
Stop losing your first hour to email. These 4 prompts clear it.

Four prompts: sort the pile, rewrite the reply, say no nicely, chase the one that never answered. Paste your email under any of them.

Save it for Monday. That's when you'll need it.

Day 2 of 30. Day 3's tomorrow, so follow if you don't want to miss it.
